system.description:
The dwarves of Tenor Hold didn't wait for blackpowder to kill things at range. They solved it decades earlier with springs, gears and spite.

  • Clockwork Precision: a repeating crossbow can be used with Two-Gun Shot (the second shot has Disadvantage, as normal), and has no Disadvantage on a Called Shot.
    • 9th level: your repeating crossbow bolts have the Armour Piercing trait.
  • Engineer's Eye: Advantage on checks to identify, maintain, repair or modify mechanical ranged weapons, and you can field-repair any crossbow or firearm during a rest.
